I fixed the "past 90d" block so it shows the main LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days. It was formatting `loc180Days` instead of `loc90Days`. The count and percentage already used the 90-day values, so the block is now consistent.

The change is one line in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`.

The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add one for this case, so your example (500 LOC vs 2.5K LOC) isn't checked.
